 Montgomery County District Court
 Cause No. 2025-CV-0005
 Samuel Carter, Plaintiff, v. Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance, Defendant
 Oral Deposition of Samuel Carter
Date:
February 26, 2026
Location:
Offices of Gardner & Morris Law Group
Examining attorney:
Richard Marshall, Ashford & Lyle LLP
Defending attorney:
Sergio Acosta, Gardner & Morris Law Group
Q: Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my full name on this record, so just use the plaintiff designation. That's fine, isn't it?
Q: We'll proceed with the designation. Whree were you when the collision occurred?
A: I was in a parking lot in Sugar Land, Texas, at a shopping center. I had just pulled into a space near the entrance.
Q: Describe what you were doing immediately before the impact.
A: I had put the car in park and was gathering my bags from the passenger seat. I wasn't moving at that point.
Q: What happened next?
A: A pickup truck backing out of the space across the aisle struck the driver's side of my vehicle. It wasn't a high-speed impact,
but it was enough to push my car sideways into the door frame and the center console.
Q: Did you get out of the vehicle?
A: Yes, but my left knee gave way when I stepped down. I caught myself on the car door. It was painful right away.
Q: Did you seek medical attention that day?
A: Not right away. I thouhgt it would settle down, so I iced it at home. By the next morning it was swollen and I couldn't bend it
fully, so I went to urgent care.
Q: What treatment have you received since then?
A: I've had physical therapy two or trhee times a week, and an orthopedic doctor recommended a brace and some restrictions on
stairs and kneeling. I still get a sharp pain when I go down stairs.
Q: How has the injury affected your daily routine?
A: I used to walk my dog every morning and go to the gym. Now I limit myself to short walks, and I've had to ask my son to help
with grocery trips because carrying bags up the front steps is hard on the knee.
Q: Have you been able to return to work?
A: Yes, I went back to my job, but I sit more than I used to and I take breaks to elevate the leg. Some days are worse than others.
Q: Do you have any prior injuries to that knee?
A: I had a minor sprain playing recreational softball many years ago. It healed fully, and I didn't have problems with it until this
collision.
</page>
